reason: This legacy artifact contained numerical lag, PCA, and leave-country-out claims derived from ineligible sentinel inputs. It has been withdrawn and must not be interpreted as evidence or a forecast.

reasons.message: Current sources lack matched measured RF exposure, verified comparable reproductive endpoints, exact geography, and complete endpoint-specific covariates.
Sparse observation positions, reconstructed series, and same-series lag selection cannot yield calendar-year lags, confidence intervals, or prospective validation.
